an5.164:1.1: tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
an5.164:1.2: pañcahāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsājīvo sabrahamacārīnaṃ
an5.164:1.4: idhāvuso bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti sīlasampadākathāya ca kataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
an5.164:1.5: attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti samādhisampadākathāya ca kataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
an5.164:1.6: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti paññāsampadākathāya ca kataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
an5.164:1.7: attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadākathāya ca kataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
an5.164:1.8: attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathāya ca kataṃ pañhaṃ byākattā hoti
an5.164:1.9: imehi kho āvuso pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃsājīvo sabrahmacārīnanti.
